notes.title: Big New Update: Guns, Sound FX, and More (Nevermind, It made it crash)
notes.content:
[strike]Hi all!

Jet and gun graphics have been completely redone, plus there are two brand new guns replacing the old one: The Plasma Cannon and the Neutrino Minigun. Make sure you pick them up in the menu by flying into the lighted hexagons, otherwise you won't have a gun.

The guns now do splash damage which is mostly for multiplayer, but you can do some fun stuff like launching yourself into the air.

Also, you can double click the menu button to toggle the HUD, and I've fixed the pink objects (most of them, I think there's still some pink lava)

I need to rebake the lighting on the city map, so it's a mess, but I was excited to push this update out so I'll do it later.[/strike]

https://youtu.be/vVhzwWTU8dA


EDIT: It was crashing, so I switched back to the older version. Will update for real soon

notes.title: Jan 8th Update
notes.content:
New stuff!

New map: City
New space station in Space map
New player model
Quieter gun sounds
New targeting system


Coming soon:

Forward facing support (turning)

Also, I wrote some new songs that will be in the game soon!
